data.name: Still heater
data.function: Resistor bonded to the still. Its power sets the 3He evaporation rate and hence the circulation rate through the whole dilution loop: more still power means more cooling power at the mixing chamber, up to the point where the still becomes too warm (above 0.9 K) and starts evaporating 4He, which contaminates the circulating gas and degrades performance.

physics.summary: Controls the circulation rate via still evaporation.

data.tooltip: Still heater: sets the 3He circulation rate.
